items.title: Ann Rabson interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, September 21, 2007
items.q: Bonnie Tallman, Ann’s manager, participated in a portion of the interview.

ctx.x: Ann Rabson latched onto the blues at an early age and has made a lifelong career of performing and composing. She is an accomplished guitarist, pianist, vocalist and songwriter, and her gigs encompass blues festivals and clubs as well as school auditoriums. Ann was a founding member of Saffire, the Uppity Blues Women, has recorded multiple solo albums, and is a W.C. Handy Award nominee.
Ann was interviewed at Hamilton College on September 21, 2007 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive. Bonnie Tallman, Ann’s manager, participated in a portion of the interview.
We are filming at Hamilton College for the Jazz Archive and I’m really pleased to have Ann Rabson with me today. And I will introduce you as one of the rare working musicians, I think, that I know.
